title: ROLLBACK TO restores a dropped column before a committed ALTER
setup: CREATE TABLE notes (body TEXT, tag TEXT);
migration: ALTER TABLE notes DROP COLUMN tag;
ALTER TABLE notes ADD COLUMN pinned INTEGER DEFAULT 0;
INSERT INTO probe SELECT count(*) FROM notes WHERE tag = 'kept' AND pinned = 0;

after.sql: CREATE TABLE notes (body TEXT, tag TEXT, pinned INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
